notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
We listened to the feedback given and updated to new and better changes!

We have increased survivability for both modes Adventure and Survival! Now you can enjoy the game without having to worry about your hunger meter as much.

Other changes we have added:
          -A stats list at the end of Survival game mode. Now you can see how many seasons survived, how 
           many items collected, and how many enemies killed.
          -Collisions have been fixed
          -Quest line for Adventure mode has changed
         -Other minor back end changes

Thank you for playing our game and providing us with great feedback. We are a small team of students who have worked on this game the last four months, and we have come a long way!
